claims.text: The data was aggregated from a variety of online public-domain sources, literary and religious texts, news magazines, and personal libraries.
Global Voices, a corpus of journalistic news text, was selected as a source for modern, colloquial text.
The dataset was significantly expanded from a majority Biblical text corpus to include millions of tokens from over a dozen sources.
